items.title: Who may charge you
items.text: Whoever orders the agent pays. One you hire is paid only once you sign, within a legal cap. We open with a licensed partner.

items.title: The rent brake
items.text: At signing the rent may not exceed the local comparative rent by more than ten percent, exceptions aside. We check, furniture surcharge included.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: At most three months' cold rent, in three instalments, kept apart from the landlord's money. Anything more is not legal.

items.title: Cold or warm
items.text: The listed rent is often cold. We read the Nebenkosten advance, what it covers, and what the yearly settlement can add.

papers.summary: The papers a German landlord asks for
papers.tail: The rest our first reply goes through.

items.q: Why isn't BOOM taking searches in Berlin yet?
items.a: Brokering a flat in Germany needs a trade permit (§34c GewO), and the law sets how a tenant-side agent is paid: only once you sign, within a cap. We open with a licensed partner. Your file waits, ready.

items.q: What can you do for me today?
items.a: Open your file, answer your questions the same working day, and tell you honestly what your budget buys in Berlin, warm and cold. The prices on this page are set; nothing is charged before the desk opens, and the Full Search fee only once you sign.

items.q: Who pays the agent in Germany?
items.a: Whoever orders the agent. A landlord's agent cannot charge you. An agent who brokers your tenancy may charge you only once the lease is signed, at most two months' net cold rent plus VAT. Full Search opens under that rule; Application Pack and Attended Viewing are charged at opening.

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Berlin, the tenant-side desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., a registered Italian agency, opening with a licensed partner (§34c GewO). Hired and paid by the tenant only.
Internationals relocating to Berlin — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
VAT included, nothing charged before the desk opens; Full Search due only on a signed lease, inside the German cap. Nothing from landlords or platforms.

Today: your file, opened and kept ready. When the desk opens: German-format dossier within one working day, applications as listings appear, attended viewings, rent brake and lease checked, Anmeldung from day one.
We don't list homes, represent landlords, promise a date, or broker in Germany before the desk opens.

footer.statement: Launching with a licensed partner. BOOM Berlin acts solely as a tenant-side desk: we do not list properties, represent landlords, or receive remuneration from landlords or their agents, and we do not broker a tenancy in Germany before the desk opens with its licensed partner.
